seen.body:
Contract: docs/specs/ledger.md, Authority and topology.
`start` posts a claim comment on the mirrored issue, re-reads comments, earliest claim comment wins; release posts a release comment. Uses create_comment/list_comments only. Unreachable primary or missing mirror refuses.
Scenarios (each a named walk whose docstring states the failure it prevents):
- golden: first claimant wins and gets claimed+claim_confirmed
- adversary: two checkouts race the same item; exactly one wins and the other writes nothing
- refusal: primary down refuses start with no event written
- refusal: item without a mirror on the primary is refused with the sync command to run
seen.title: Atomic claim reservation on the primary forge
